Infernus.why: Burn carry and one of the patch's few clean sustain winners: Haunt bounty/growth +10% pays a one-cycle burn clear that barely eats the Haunt HP/damage increase, and Spirit Lifesteal (+2 spirit/+2%), Toxic Bullets' 40% heal-cut and Napalm T2 lifesteal 15->20% all feed his farm-and-kite shell. He still folds to displacement-plus-burst that negates low-HP kiting (Dynamo, Bebop), and the slower comeback economy means his late spike now arrives on time more often.
Infernus.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Napalm T2 lifesteal 15->20 and Concussive Combustion T3 +0.4 spirit scaling lift the Dashfernus line; Spirit Lifesteal +2 spirit/+2% lifesteal and Toxic Bullets' 40% heal-cut pay his camp route, and Haunt bounty/growth +10% is nearly free for a one-cycle burn clear.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Healing Snacks heal through burn and Buff-Container Spirit Resist is permanent and unstrippable, so the camp-AoE gain no longer nets out positive; Barrel Mimics punish the crate walks he has no heavy melee for.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): grouped Haunt camps suit his burn AoE and Buff Containers roll Ability Range/Move Speed for his spirit build; the tempo shift still ends games before his late spike.

Seven.why: Jungle-payout carry: Haunt bounty and growth +10% lands squarely on the fastest one-cycle clearer in the game, and the new comeback levers (30% non-hero cap, tick souls to the two poorest) finally give a behind Seven a way back, removing the 'lead-only' cap that held him at A. The +10% Haunt HP/damage barely costs a one-pass clear, and Static Charge T3 stun 0.9->1.1s adds lockdown to the ability he uses to hold camps and fights — he still dies to dives and Hook CC-locks before his AoE is up.
Seven.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Static Charge T3 stun 0.9->1.1s; Spirit Lifesteal +2/+2% and Healbane's multi-source anti-heal stacking are both core, and Haunt bounty/growth +10% is pure profit for the fastest one-cycle clearer — the new comeback levers also drop the 'farm a lead only' cap on a behind Seven.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): nine behavior-varied Haunt types (grouped/chasing) make the fastest camp clear the biggest income lever in the game; he has no crate or Barrel Mimic route and does not need one.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): fastest Haunt-camp clear plus telegraphed Plaza/Bell Tower hub fights push him B->A; the no-comeback economy still caps a behind Seven.

Vindicta.why: Max-range poke carry whose range guarantee is gone: High-Velocity Rounds velocity 60->45% means fewer max-range hits land, and air drag 0.35->0.5 slows every airborne exit, so she still wants the roofs and telegraphed hub fights but now pays the flyer tax twice. Her gun core is intact, so this is a weaker version of the same hero rather than a dead one.
countered_by: global slows and air drag 0.35->0.5 on airborne exits
Vindicta.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, indirect): High-Velocity Rounds velocity 60->45% removes the max-range guarantee her gun core buys first and air drag 0.35->0.5 taxes every airborne exit; the roofs and hub-fight value are unchanged, the range is not.
City Never Sleeps (09-29, indirect): new roofs/high ground and telegraphed Plaza/Bell Tower hub fights favor her max-range poke; flyer tax unchanged.
09-16 (indirect): global slows now bite air drag and Silver's Weighted Bola grounds Flight — anti-flyer tax offsets her tempo gains, so she held A.

Lady Geist.why: Regen frontline whose engine lost its out-of-combat half: Radiant Regeneration now heals only in combat at 65->40 base with boon 1.7->1.4 and spirit 0.35->0.25, and she buys it in 98% of games, while Decay's -55% incoming-heal penalty deepens on her own sustain. The Essence Bomb 1.22->1.35 spirit buff is real but only pays the Soul-Exchange variant, and the new tick-soul comeback softens her slow start without replacing the regen she lost.

builds.name: Regen gun-bruiser
builds.notes: Regen-first opener still survives a losing lane, but the out-of-combat half is gone: Radiant Regeneration only fires in combat now, so Juggernaut (+8->+15 regen) replaces the Healing Booster line as the cheap regen top-up; Soul Exchange remains the finisher.

builds.name: Spirit Soul-Exchange
builds.notes: Caster-leaning variant; Essence Bomb 1.22->1.35 buys the kill window, but the trimmed spirit scaling on Radiant Regeneration (0.35->0.25) hits the variant that stacks the most spirit hardest, so sustain shifts into Spirit Lifesteal.

Lady Geist.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Essence Bomb 1.22->1.35 spirit scaling only pays the Soul-Exchange line; Radiant Regeneration becomes in-combat-only at 65->40/1.7->1.4/0.35->0.25 on a 98%-buy slot, and Decay's incoming-heal penalty deepens -50->-55% on a core slot she fights out of.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder camps plus Barrel Mimic fights make farm a sustain check her regen stack passes, and container Bullet/Spirit Resist rolls add free frontline stats; the same dive heroes still eat her.
10-14: Radiant Regeneration spirit scaling 0.04->0.035 (third cumulative trim) narrows her ~98%-buy regen core; the Spirit Soul-Exchange variant, which stacks the most spirit power, loses most.

Abrams.why: Melee tank who still owns the routes ranged kits cannot contest — Tough Crates and Barrel Mimics — and the patch's in-fight props (Torment Pulse +4% melee resist, Battle Vest 18->22%, Bullet Lifesteal) suit his brawl better than his old aura did. Hunter's Aura's LOS gate is the cost: it no longer shreds through walls on the Shoulder Charge approach, so his engage pays one window later than it used to.

builds.name: Melee brawler (gun)
builds.notes: Still the ~80-90% default: cheap Close Quarters/Monster Rounds spike the early melee trade, then Battle Vest (18->22% weapon damage) carries the brawl while Hunter's Aura is taken later — its new LOS gate means it no longer pays before contact, which is exactly the approach distance he buys tank stats to survive.

builds.name: CC/sustain tank (spirit)
builds.notes: Late-game defensive layer (avg buy 17-26m) that extends Seismic Impact/Siphon Life with Superior Duration + Duration Extender and blinks him onto targets via Warp Stone/Phantom Strike; the answer to being kited and anti-healed.

Abrams.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): base gun damage +5% and Siphon Life T3 +18->+22 DPS are small fight-length gains, but the Shoulder Charge fix removes his free hold on enemies who never hit a wall; Hunter's Aura is now LOS-gated, so Battle Vest/Bullet Lifesteal (which never turn off) compete for the same slot.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Barrel Mimics convert breakable-chaining into a sustain check his heavy-melee + Siphon core passes, making the uncontestable crate route safer than it is for squishy gun clearers.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): his melee core remains the cheap route into the Haunt/crate farm and the objective-parry change keeps dives on him risky; frontline up, anti-tank Shiv his real counter.

Wraith.why: Fire-rate gun carry with a high floor and no growth path: the 09-16 spirit on-hit gutting pushed her fully onto fire-rate M1, and this patch only trims her Card Trick heal 60->45 and Project Mind (46->50s, initial cast 0.75->1s) without touching the gun core. Cheap anti-gun defence got better in the same patch (Bullet Resilience 30->35%, Return Fire's 10% bullet resist now on the tooltip), so she outclasses no one in her slot.
Wraith.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Card Trick heal 60->45 and Project Mind 46->50s with a slower 0.75->1s initial cast trim the only sustain and the repositioning her survival plan runs on; her fire-rate gun core (Monster Rounds/Quicksilver Reload/Rapid Rounds/Swift Striker/Ricochet) is untouched.
09-16: Card Trick heal 75->60, heal scaling 0.75->0.5, resist shred -8->-7% (T3 -5->-4%), T3 slow +20->+15%; Mercurial Magnum + Spiritual Overflow gutted and Plated Armor now blanks Full Auto spirit damage — on-hit-spirit core weakened, lean pure gun.
Creator-cited Capacitor/Slowing Hex appear in none of the top-15 item slots; usage says the real core was spirit on-hit (Quicksilver Reload 100%, Mercurial Magnum 93%) — Magnum now weakened.

McGinnis.why: Turret zone controller whose farm got cheaper and better paid: Mini Turret 50->65% vs troopers plus 9->10 HP per boon speeds lane and camp clearing on a jungle that pays 10% more bounty and growth, and turrets clear grouped Haunts from cover without ever taking the +10% Haunt damage. Her hub-fight zoning is unchanged, so the gain is income and uptime, not fight impact.
McGinnis.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Mini Turret damage vs troopers 50->65% and health per boon 9->10 speed her lane farm and turret uptime, and Haunt bounty/growth +10% rewards a kit that clears grouped camps from cover without eating the +10% Haunt damage.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): the map's four off-lane corridors spread fights away from her turret/wall setup, flattening the hub-fight gain; turrets still clear grouped Haunt camps and Barrel Mimics from cover.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): turrets clear the new grouped Haunt camps and zone the telegraphed Plaza/Bell Tower hubs, while the objective-parry change punishes dives into her wall.

Paradox.why: Carbine pick/sniper who traded pick quality for frequency: Paradoxical Swap at 95s buys her an extra pick per fight cycle, but Express Shot -5% secondary fire and HVR 60->45% velocity weaken the crit-carbine burst that pick converts, and Steam Vents now sell stamina instead of the invisibility approach her roams used. The ability-burst line gains relative value over the crit line; anything that closes distance still kills her.
enabled_by: instant casts (carbine->swap combo fires on input, not the next window)
new districts/hiding spots (roamer pick setups; ahead of Bebop)
Paradox.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Paradoxical Swap 110->95s adds a pick per fight cycle; Express Shot -5% secondary-fire damage and HVR velocity 60->45% cut the carbine crit burst, and the Steam Vent rework (stamina regen instead of invisibility) removes the approach her roams leaned on — ability burst (Slowing Hex/Compress Cooldown/Tankbuster) now outranks the HVR/Express Shot crit line.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): instant casts tighten her carbine->swap combo, and Barrel Mimics leave squishy crate clearers stationary for picks; mobile divers still close on her.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): new districts, more hiding spots and Steam-Vent invisibility sharpen her roamer pick setups and keep her ahead of Bebop in that slot; the sniper line still folds to mobile divers.

Haze.why: Tempo gun carry whose own damage is untouched — Fixation still decides her games — but the answers to it got cheaper: Return Fire now returns Fixation damage on frontline tanks who already bought it, Bullet Resilience is 30->35%, and Smoke Bomb T3 no longer dispels undispellable debuffs. Same carry, one fewer escape and a real counter-slot on the enemy front line.
Haze.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Smoke Bomb T3 no longer dispels undispellable debuffs (e.g. Specter Crash), and Return Fire now returns Fixation damage plus shows its 10% bullet resist on the tooltip, handing frontline tanks the anti-Haze slot they were already buying; Bullet Resilience 30->35% adds a second cheap answer.
09-16 (indirect): Plated Armor's on-hit fix now blanks Tesla Bullets spirit damage, weakening her Ricochet/Tesla late pivot.
Role reframed per reader: farm-carry is meta-dependent, not her identity — historically a Smoke Bomb roamer/ganker on isolated targets, and T4 weakness gates the late-scaler label.

Calico.why: Melee-spirit assassin whose burst window grew — Leaping Slash T3 +60->+90 and Ava T3 6->8s — on a jungle that pays 10% more per camp she takes by kill rather than clear. The Steam Vent rework removes one invisibility approach and the comeback levers punish a snowball that stalls, so she is a sharper diver with less margin; stacked-HP frontlines still cap her.
Calico.notes:
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Leaping Slash T3 +60->+90 damage and Ava T3 6->8s sharpen her melee-spirit burst and second pick; the Steam Vent rework (stamina regen instead of invisibility) trims one roam route, and the raised non-hero comeback gold + tick souls punish a snowball that stalls.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): districts and vent invisibility extend her roam; cat form still can't heavy-melee Tough Crates, and the frontline meta gives her more unburstable bodies.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): tempo snowball plus new district/Steam-Vent routes suit her roam; cat form still cannot heavy-melee Tough Crates, so lean kills/off-map souls.

change_log: Infernus: trend stable -> rising (Napalm T2 lifesteal 15->20, Spirit Lifesteal +2/+2%, Toxic Bullets 40% heal-cut, Haunt bounty +10%); tier stays B, notes truncated to 3 lines.
Seven: tier A -> S, trend rising (Haunt bounty/growth +10% on the fastest one-cycler, Static Charge T3 stun 1.1s, comeback levers remove the lead-only cap).
Vindicta: tier A -> B, trend rising -> falling; countered_by adds the HVR velocity 60->45% cut (no max-range guarantee) alongside air drag.

Lady Geist: tier A -> B, trend stable -> falling; builds updated (Juggernaut into regen gun-bruiser, Spirit Lifesteal into Spirit Soul-Exchange) because Radiant Regeneration lost its out-of-combat half.
Abrams: trend rising -> stable; melee brawler build swaps in Battle Vest and demotes Hunter's Aura behind it (LOS gate).
Wraith: why/notes rewritten for the Card Trick 60->45 and Project Mind 46->50s trims; tier and trend unchanged (B, falling).
McGinnis: trend stable -> rising (Mini Turret 50->65% vs troopers, 9->10 HP per boon, jungle pays 10% more).
Paradox: trend rising -> stable; enabled_by drops Steam Vent invisibility (now stamina regen) and adds Paradoxical Swap 110->95s.
Haze: trend rising -> stable (Return Fire returns Fixation, Smoke Bomb T3 loses undispellable dispel, Bullet Resilience 30->35%).
Calico: enabled_by drops the stale 'comeback-soul nerf' premise and adds Leaping Slash T3 +90 / Ava T3 8s.
